name: Pycnogenol
summary: Pycnogenol is a standardized French maritime pine bark extract (Horphag) with 160+ clinical trials. A 2022 Belgian RCT (n=88 children with ADHD) found teacher-rated ADHD scores down ~29% and hyperactivity/impulsivity down ~34% vs placebo; a 2024 network meta-analysis (48 studies, n=3,650) ranked it top antioxidant for teacher-rated attention. A September 2026 manufacturer PR push is overselling the cognition story.
description: Canonical pycnogenol research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until branded-ingredient (Horphag) vs generic pine bark boundaries are explicit, ADHD vs general-cognition indications are separated, and marketing claims are checked against trial data, passing the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: antioxidant activity; endothelial nitric oxide; attention regulation
